subject: [PATCH v5 19/19] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap whole PMD-aligned areas of page tables, rather than just individual pages or tables. This is done to test a specific scenario where a collapse walks the same table as another process zapping it. The change aims to improve the robustness and testing of the kernel's memory management features.
